$comment: Which build-time environment variables may reach the frontend bundle. `public` is the allow-list vite.config.ts hands to Vite as envPrefix (full variable names, so a prefix match is an exact match): OAuth client ids, redirect URL overrides and the Tauri debug flag. `secret` is what build.rs compiles into Sigil.exe (lightly XOR-obfuscated, see src-tauri/embed_codec.rs, which is NOT protection) and what src/ and vite.config.ts must never name. Nothing may be in both lists. Names only: never put a value in this file. Read by vite.config.ts, src-tauri/build.rs, scripts/release/check-no-secrets.mjs and the tests that guard them.
